title: How Gentiles should read the Law’s journey
english: [[Paul, teacher of the nations in faith and truth >> Bible:1 Timothy 2:7]], handed the Gentile church a way to read books of Law once foreign to them. He gives patterns of understanding so we may watch for like things. Israel’s departure is the soul’s schooling as it leaves the Egypt of the passions.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: From Ramesse to Succoth
english: [[The children of Israel set out from Rameses and came to Succoth >> Bible:Exodus 12:37]]. Leave the world’s noisy “Rameses” and pitch Succoth’s tents — the life of sojourners who no longer settle in Egypt’s brickworks.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Watch-tower and ascent
english: Moses is told to look out as from a watch-tower. Ascent belongs to deeds; the lookout belongs to faith. Seeing Pharaoh’s host behind, the people must stand still and see the Lord’s salvation.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Following Moses — the Law — on the road
english: If you walk this road following Moses — that is, God’s Law — you have the [[pillar of cloud and fire >> Bible:Exodus 13:21]]. Do not turn back to Egypt’s [[fleshpots >> Bible:Exodus 16:3]]; the rear-guard of Pharaoh still hopes you will.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Rod strikes the sea — Homilia V CLOSEOUT
english: Moses is commanded to [[strike the sea with his rod >> Bible:Exodus 14:16]] so a dry path opens. It figures baptism: enemies sink, the people pass through [[baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:1-2]]. Christ opens the way through water. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
